purpose: Add a candidate-neutral binary-table index for the hash-pinned Fermi rsp2 response histories. Read scalar energy bounds, segment intervals and variable-array descriptors to expose exact selection alternatives without reading response coefficients, selecting a response, fitting a likelihood or changing the established T-054/T-059/T-061 methods.

parser_dependencies.purpose: FITS header parser and byte locator reused for provenance only
Existing response-history schema vocabulary; no matrix-value reader reused

query_grid.reference: TRIGTIME in the hash-pinned FITS header
query_grid.role: Fixed audit fixture for selection ambiguity; not fitted and not a physical timing observation

covering.rule: Include every positive-duration segment with TSTART <= query <= TSTOP; include a zero-duration segment only when query equals its endpoint.

nearest.rule: Choose the segment minimizing absolute query-minus-center distance.

interpolation_bracket.rule: Choose adjacent ordered segment centers c_lower <= query <= c_upper with c_lower < c_upper.
interpolation_bracket.selection: No bracket is selected as a production response; both alternatives remain reported.

assumptions: The parent response-history manifest remains authoritative for product identity, official locators, byte lengths, SHA-256 values and local cache keys.
FITS binary-table scalar values and variable-array descriptors can be read with the declared big-endian table layout without interpreting response coefficients.
The fixed relative query offsets are a reproducibility fixture only; they are not selected from the data or used to tune a candidate.
Segment centers and interval endpoints are metadata for reporting selection alternatives, not a timing likelihood or uncertainty model.
The existing T-054 forward method, T-059 inverse method, T-061 owner order and promotion firewalls remain controlling.
missing_assumptions: A source-owned rule linking response-history segments to event windows, spectral-history validity and calibration interpolation.
A detector-to-geocenter propagation conversion with uncertainty and a common time standard across instruments.
Frozen detector, energy, background and temporal windows with source-owned selection semantics.
A source-owned joint timing likelihood or component/shared covariance with calibration and intrinsic-emission nuisance terms.
A complete candidate-neutral F_reg/F_lim/F_eff/F_obs map and immutable scorer.
A prospective holdout not used for source selection, response selection or estimator design.
evidence_level: T0 exact public-product byte check plus binary-table structure and selection-ambiguity index; no response coefficient or model test
non_claims: This contract does not choose nearest, covering or interpolation as a production response and does not read or interpret response-matrix coefficients.
The descriptor and EBOUNDS checks do not establish calibration validity, detector-to-geocenter timing, a likelihood, covariance, nuisance law, candidate score or prediction.
The finite response-history index does not identify microscopic dynamics, causal propagation or a physical Yang-Mills sector.
No Pre-A, C6, A13, Sector-A, QFT, Yang-Mills, gravity, continuum, physical-vacuum, cosmic-origin, theory-of-everything or mass-gap claim follows.
The established T-054 forward and T-059/T-061 observation-first methods are unchanged; this is additive owner-intake bookkeeping only.
next_action: Request a source-owned validity/interpolation and timing-uncertainty rule for these indexed segments. Keep all response alternatives, matrix values and scoring locked; only after the owner contract is complete may an event-free F_reg reproduction be considered.
